environment.description: Spring Boot application running on EKS cluster in namespace 'notifications-prod'. The admin panel at /admin/notifications renders the 'content' and 'raw_payload' columns using Thymeleaf th:utext (unescaped). SQS queue accepts messages from multiple producer services. No Content-Security-Policy header is set on the admin panel responses. Pod runs with default Kubernetes network policies (allow-all). IAM role attached via IRSA with sqs:ReceiveMessage, sqs:DeleteMessage, and rds-data:ExecuteStatement permissions.
